title: 機器分析化学
subtitle: Instrumental Analytical Chemistry
educationalGoal: You will learn absorption spectrophotometry for the determination of ions and substances, IR and NMR for structural analysis of organic compounds, X-ray analysis methods, and thermal analysis methods. You will learn the basic principles of each analytical method and the information provided by each method.
advice:
You will learn the importance of instrumental analysis in actual analysis. You will learn the basic principles of each analytical method and the information that can be obtained by each analytical method.
1. Role of instrumental analysis
2. Absorption spectrophotometry
3. Atomic absorption spectrometry (AAS)
4. Optical emission spectrometry (OES)
5. X-ray analysis
6. Thermal analysis
7. Infrared spectroscopy (IR)
8. Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR)
books:
Textbooks: Unspecified
Reference books: Bunseki Kagaku no Kiso (Shokabou Publishing), Kiki Bunseki (Shokabou Publishing), Nyumon Kiki Bunseki Kagaku (Sankyo Shuppan Publishing), Bunseki Kagaku II Bunseki Kagaku (Maruzen Publishing)
Reserved books: Kiso Kara Wakaru Kiki Bunseki (Morikita Shuppan Publishing)
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, and organic chemistry is required. Bring a scientific calculator to classes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the principles of absorption spectrophotometry.
Be able to understand the principles and characteristics of AAS and OES
Be able to apply IR and NMR to estimate the structure of organic compounds.
Be able to understand the principles and characteristics of X-ray analysis and thermal analysis.

achievementLevels.ideal: Can understand and explain the principles and characteristics of each instrumental analytical method. Can also select the optimum instrumental analytical method to obtain specific information and design an analytical method for it.
achievementLevels.standard: Can understand and explain the principles and characteristics of each instrumental analytical method to some extent. Can also select the optimum instrumental analytical method to obtain specific information and design an analytical method for it after consulting textbooks and other references.
